neighbours.label: ' however' as a parenthetical inserted mid-clause between commas
fire: The rain, however, did not stop the parade.
Rumors spread, however, that the coach was leaving.
Her brother, however, refused to sign the letter.
The museum, however, stayed open late on Fridays.
News leaked, however, that the merger was off.
Most guests, however, left before midnight.
The second test, however, showed no change.
Prices fell, however, once the harvest came in.
quiet: The heavy rain did not stop the parade.
Rumors spread quickly that the coach was leaving.
Her brother also refused to sign the letter.
The museum still stayed open late on Fridays.
News leaked yesterday that the merger was off.
Most guests left well before midnight.
The second test showed no change at all.
Prices fell sharply once the harvest came in.

notes: weak early pole (max 2.17). Card tops are mixed discourse markers (' however', ' indeed', Arabic 'ولكن'). Probes: ', however,' 0.17-0.51, ' indeed' 0.08, same sentence without however 0.03-0.13.
